review_contract.source_of_truth: The checked-in inventory supplies name, kind, addon, source, line, variables and document sha256; this catalog owns only P01 contract metadata.
review_contract.query_policy: Every query is replay_safe and has readback_plan=not_applicable.
review_contract.mutation_policy: Every mutation declares side-effect, connector/Shopify idempotency, exact readback and uncertainty handling before registration; possible-after-send failures never blind-replay.
review_contract.live_canary_policy: live_canary_family identifies the minimum family-level 2026-07 canary; no live call is performed by this catalog.
